subject.title: Add retry logic to OAuth token refresh

question: Which cross-provider OAuth refresh errors should retry in the shared auth-profile path, and what maximum retry delay is acceptable while the refresh lock is held?
rationale: This policy changes authentication availability and upstream request behavior for multiple OAuth providers; code inspection alone cannot safely choose the permanent shared contract.

options.title: Adopt bounded transient retries
options.body: Retry only classified network, timeout, and retriable server failures with a small capped budget, while surfacing invalid-grant and other terminal OAuth failures immediately.

options.title: Retain single-shot refresh
options.body: Keep the current shared recovery-only behavior and require provider-specific or caller-level handling for transient refresh failures.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded transient retries
recommendation.body: Retry only classified network, timeout, and retriable server failures with a small capped budget, while surfacing invalid-grant and other terminal OAuth failures immediately.
